top_signals.title: Asian Markets React as Trump Cools Iran Fears
top_signals.summary: President Trump stated he has no immediate plans for further strikes on Iran, easing geopolitical risk across the region. The remarks triggered a sharp decline in crude oil and fueled a broad rally across Asian equities. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
